project_info.theme: Shopee Mall Super Brand Day beauty multi-brand campaign
project_info.color_palette: Soft white, blush pink, black, coral orange, blue accent

main_subject.detail: A polished beauty promo poster with header logos for Shopee Mall SuperBrandDay, Maybelline New York, L'Oreal Paris, Garnier, and 3CE StyleNanda. Large date text says '12.07-14.07'. Main headline reads 'PHAN MIN, BEN SAC DA SANG - TOC TREND*'. A rounded central offer bar says 'UU DAI DEN 50% | QUA TANG 500.000D'. On a black display stage sit a large Fit Me Loose Setting Powder, a L'Oreal glycolic serum dropper bottle, a 3CE lip product, and a Garnier Color Naturals product pack. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'. Top-right badge reads 'CON 2 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'.
main_subject.style: Premium multi-brand beauty campaign poster with clean display-podium composition and soft glossy highlights
